config.decision: 8 criteria (see report section 17); no post-result tuning

dual_score.description: Phase-11 default control: evict lowest retention_priority.

base_score_only.description: Evict lowest base_score (write-time value only: no retrieval_access_count, no current_importance, no last_access_turn).

task_affinity.description: Evict lexicographically lowest (task_affinity, retention_priority); task_affinity = top-4 cosine to the recent run of fact-carrying turns.

oracle_future_use.description: Evict lowest future_use (0 before 1) — OFFLINE-ONLY theoretical upper bound.

e15_audit.note: E15's token-based obsolete_retention can only fire when a forbidden answer token is present in injected context; the token census quantifies how often that token legitimately lives in unrelated gt facts.

verdict.rationale: task_affinity vs dual_score future-use retention recall at low store ([256, 512]): 0.0709 vs 0.0802; precision 1.0 vs 1.0; per-seed wins 0/5; oracle store gap task 0.009 vs dual -0.0003.
